Fifth prototype release of RTA-SUM LNM for SDV 2.0. \newline \\  Modified name of the port interface WdgM_LocalSupervision in section \ref{subsec:LNM MainFunction} and table in section \ref{section:Generic Component Interface}.\\ Section \ref{sec:IEF}  and  \ref{section:Generic Component Interface} updated, removing the RP_ERRH_LNM_Ief_DTC_Confirm and PP_LNM_SSM_IefFA port.

Third prototype release of RTA-SUM LNM 8.0.1 for SDV 2.0. \newline  \\ Updated section \ref{subsec:LNM MainFunction}: Added VehiclePowerMode. \\ Updated contents in section \ref{LNM Diagnostic}. \\ Updated section \ref{section:Generic Component Interface}: Added RP_SUSD_LNM_VehiclePowerMode port. \\ Updated Figure \ref{fig:containergeneral} and subsection \ref{sec:LNM Containers} to include new calibration parameter. \\ Updated interfaces in picture and table in section \ref{section:Generic Component Interface}: removed interfaces PP_LNM_SSM_LossComm and RP_ERRH_LNM_NodeStatusIdx.

Fourth prototype release of RTA-SUM LNM 8.0.1 for SDV 2.0. \newline \\ Updated section \ref{section:Generic Component Interface}, \ref{section:Definitions}, \ref{section:overview} \\ Updating all naming convention from slave/master to responder/commander. \\ Update section \ref{subsec:SchMgnt}: Added note for Pre-sleep calibration parameter. \\ Update section \ref{subsec:LNM MainFunction} and \ref{subsec:Network activation}: Added rule support for activation criteria. \\ Update section \ref{subsec:ProjSpecificLogicExp}: Added VPM as signal type.\\ Update section \ref{sec:UsrFuncs}: Updated figures.\\ Update section \ref{subsec:Network configuration}: Added example for activation and schedule management with activation rule.

Fifth prototype release of RTA-SUM LNM 8.0.1 for SDV 2.0. \newline \\ Updated sections \ref{sec:LNM Containers} and \ref{subsec:init} to reflect the addition of a configuration parameter for the periodicity of the init runnable.
Eighth prototype release of RTA-SUM LNM 8.0.1 for SDV 2.0. \newline \\ Added section \ref{sec:inputvalidation} to enable input validation in the arxml bamf.
